name: Confidence Updating with Detached Color Network
definition: A strategy to identify inlier and outlier poses by updating confidence scores based on rendering quality from a detached color network, solving the issue where outliers might have higher PSNR than inliers due to shape-radiance ambiguity.
summary: Confidence Updating with Detached Color Network improves pose filtering by using a view-independent color network to generate reliable confidence scores, overcoming shape-radiance ambiguities that mislead traditional metrics.
